parameters.query:
insert into suppression_list (phone_hash, source) values ($1, 'sms_stop')
on conflict (phone_hash) do nothing

insert into consent_events (call_id, phone_hash, phone_last4, kind, script_ver, channel)
values ($1, $2, $3, 'sms_opt_out', 'v1.0', 'sms')
returning id

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ from_number: $('Extract message').first().json.to_number, to_number: $('Extract message').first().json.from_number, override_agent_id: $env.RETELL_OPTOUT_AGENT_ID, metadata: { purpose: 'sms_opt_out_confirmation' }, retell_llm_dynamic_variables: { practice_name: String($env.PRACTICE_NAME || ''), fixed_reply: "You're unsubscribed from " + String($env.PRACTICE_NAME || 'our') + ' texts.' } }) }}

nodes.name: Retell: reply once
nodes.notes: TODO: Retell exposes no plain single-message SMS endpoint. This uses POST /create-sms-chat with a dedicated opt-out agent (RETELL_OPTOUT_AGENT_ID) whose prompt sends {{fixed_reply}} once and ends the chat. Verify the endpoint still matches https://docs.retellai.com/api-references/create-sms-chat before go-live.

parameters.query:
insert into phi_access_log (actor, action, call_id, patient_ref, appointment_ref, location, outcome, detail)
values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8::jsonb)
returning id

options.queryReplacement: ={{ ['n8n', 'sms_opt_out', $('Extract message').first().json.chat_id, null, null, null, ($json.error ? 'error' : 'ok'), JSON.stringify({ channel: 'sms', reply_sent: !$json.error })] }}
